title: Compiler Manifests
description: Diagnostics and metadata from the compilation step that produced the executable backend artifact. Joined to runs on run_id.

run_id.description: Foreign key into the runs table. Each run has at most one compiler manifest row.

compiler.description: Compiler or converter tool used to produce the backend artifact.

compiler_version.description: Version string of the compiler tool.

compilation_time_ms.description: Wall-clock time spent during compilation in milliseconds.

optimization_flags.description: List of optimization flags or compiler options passed during compilation.

deployment_target.description: Minimum deployment target (OS version) required by the compiled artifact.

diagnostics.description: Free-form JSON containing compiler warnings, errors, heuristics, and optimization decisions. Schema not yet normalized across compiler versions.
